app_metadata.name: Royal Solutions ERP
app_metadata.description: Unified platform serving three core requirements: Learning Management (LMS), Client Relationship Management (CRM), and Internal Operational Control (Staff, Finance, Complaints).

replication_stack.backend: PHP 8.1+ (Procedural and page-centric structure; NOT MVC, no routing framework. Each page is a standalone script combining business logic and UI templates, referencing shared inclusion helpers)
replication_stack.database: MySQL (using native mysqli extension with strict parameterized prepared statements)
replication_stack.frontend: HTML5, Vanilla JS, Tailwind CSS CDN (v3/v4), Google Fonts (Outfit / Inter), Lucide Icons (via CDN)
replication_stack.authentication: Custom Session-based auth with OTP (One-Time Password) login verification
replication_stack.payments: Paystack API Integration (simulated and live gateway support)

ui_design_guidelines.aesthetics: Premium modern web design, superior to the React implementation in visual styling.

light.accent: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-600 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-indigo-750 text-white

fonts.monospace: Fira Code, monospace (used for codes, transactions, signatures)

features: Glassmorphism styling (backdrop-blur-md on cards and overlays)
Micro-animations on hover (scale, shadow glow, slide transitions)
Skeletons and spinners for asynchronous/fetching states (using HTML templates)
Interactive widgets with real-time UI response (e.g. search filters, tab toggles without full reload where applicable)
Highly responsive layouts optimized for Mobile, Tablet, and Desktop screens

root.includes: Shared layout templates (header.php, footer.php, sidebar.php, auth_guard.php, helpers.php).
root.uploads: Folders for housing uploaded files (assignments, documents, profiles).
root.assets: Static css (for custom scrollbars and animations) and vanilla javascripts.
root.api: Independent PHP action endpoints serving JSON data back to Ajax requests (OTP verify, forum likes, search filters).
root.login.php: Entry page presenting sign-in/sign-up forms and OTP validation overlay.
root.student/: Standalone student portal pages (dashboard.php, my_courses.php, learning_view.php, assignments.php, results.php, billing.php, forum.php).
root.client/: Standalone client portal pages (dashboard.php, projects.php, proposals.php, billing.php, vault.php, meetings.php).
root.staff/: Standalone staff/instructor pages (dashboard.php, classes.php, grading.php, upload_resource.php).
root.admin/: Standalone administrative pages (dashboard.php, user_control.php, course_setup.php, project_control.php, ledger.php, reports.php).

users.description: Main user accounts table, replacing Clerk user records.
users.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  email VARCHAR(191) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  username VARCHAR(191) UNIQUE NULL,
  first_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  last_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
  phone VARCHAR(20) NULL,
  avatar VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  status ENUM('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'PENDING_VERIFICATION') DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  role ENUM('STUDENT', 'CLIENT', 'STAFF', 'ADMIN', 'MANAGER') DEFAULT 'STUDENT',
  referral_code VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NULL,
  last_active DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  email_verified TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

profiles.sql:
CREATE TABLE profiles (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id VARCHAR(36) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  full_name VARCHAR(200) NULL,

  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

user_settings.sql:
CREATE TABLE user_settings (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id VARCHAR(36) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  language VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'english',
  timezone VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT 'Africa/Lagos',

  push_notifications TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
  assignment_reminders TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
  grade_alerts TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
  class_reminders TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
  announcements TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
  marketing_emails TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  privacy_visibility VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'public',
  show_email TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  show_phone TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  data_sharing TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,
  analytics TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 1,

balances.description: System balance tracking per user (wallet balance / virtual funds).
balances.sql:

activities.sql:

notifications.sql:
CREATE TABLE notifications (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  message TEXT NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'GENERAL',
  priority ENUM('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH') DEFAULT 'MEDIUM',
  is_read TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  archived TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0,
  link VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  metadata JSON NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  INDEX idx_user_read (user_id, is_read),
  INDEX idx_user_created (user_id, created_at),
  INDEX idx_user_archived (user_id, archived)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

students.sql:

courses.sql:
CREATE TABLE courses (

  duration VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,

classes.description: Assigned cohort or class instances of a course.

class_students.description: Pivot table assigning students to active classes.
class_students.sql:
CREATE TABLE class_students (

class_resources.description: Resource materials specifically uploaded for individual classes.
class_resources.sql:

enrollments.description: Student course enrollment and status tracking.
enrollments.sql:
CREATE TABLE enrollments (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  student_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  course_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  enrollment_date DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  status ENUM('ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED', 'DROPPED', 'SUSPENDED') DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  progress INT DEFAULT 0,
  completion_date DATETIME NULL,
  payment_type ENUM('FULL', 'INSTALLMENT') DEFAULT 'FULL',
  total_paid DECIMAL(15,2) DEFAULT 0.00,

  FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES students(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_student_course (student_id, course_id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

assignments.description: Student homework tasks and submissions status.
assignments.sql:
CREATE TABLE assignments (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  course_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  student_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(191) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT NULL,
  due_date DATETIME NULL,
  status ENUM('PENDING', 'SUBMITTED', 'GRADED', 'OVERDUE') DEFAULT 'PENDING',
  submission VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  grade INT NULL,
  feedback TEXT NULL,
  submitted_at DATETIME NULL,
  graded_at DATETIME NULL,
  created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (course_id) REFERENCES courses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (student_id) REFERENCES students(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;

results.sql:

authentication_authorization.signup_flow: Role-based selection (Student or Client) -> Input details (Zod-equivalent server-side validation) -> Generate a verification code/OTP saved in session -> Trigger email/SMS notification (with dummy simulator log file support) -> Code entry validation -> Create record inside 'users' and associated 'students' or 'clients' tables via transactional insert.
authentication_authorization.login_flow: Input email -> Check if user exists -> If ACTIVE, generate OTP -> Mail/SMS OTP -> Check matching OTP -> Set secure PHP Session variable with user ID, role, and last_active. Redirect user to respective dashboard (/student, /client, /staff, /admin).
authentication_authorization.route_guards: Page-level session guards (via require_once '../includes/auth_guard.php'). Every standalone page includes this guard script at the top to check session existence and verify that the user's role has permission to access that specific portal page. Unauthenticated requests are immediately redirected back to '/login.php'.

student_portal.dashboard: Key indicators: total course progress summary, overdue assignments count, upcoming classes widget, active forum updates list, and finance summary (unpaid balance details). Styled with cards containing hover micro-animations.
student_portal.course_catalog: Complete course listing. Filter by mode (ONLINE/OFFLINE), level, category, and title. Single course view displays description, module list, instructor bio, full price, and installment payment pricing.
student_portal.learning_interface: Sidebar listing modules and nested lessons. Main workspace contains HTML5 video player, rich-text lesson notes, file attachments download link, and a 'Mark Lesson Complete' button that increments progress counter asynchronously via AJAX.
student_portal.assignments: Tabular list of assigned homeworks showing due dates, grading status (PENDING, SUBMITTED, GRADED, OVERDUE), and grade score. Clicking details reveals submission form (PDF or zip upload with verification check) and teacher's rich-text feedback.
student_portal.results_certificates: List of exams completed. Displays raw score, max score, percentage, and grade letter. If the course is completed (100% progress and exams passed), reveals a 'Download Certificate' button. Renders certificate template with dynamic student/course metadata and a unique QR code (linking to /verify-certificate?id=...).
student_portal.billing_installments: List of transaction payments (completed and pending dues). For installment payment structure, lists amount, due date, status, and custom Paystack Checkout button triggering JS payment gateway popup.
student_portal.student_forum: Peer-to-peer discussion forum. Create post forms with course attachments, filter tags (General, Coding, Help), search queries, and real-time like/reply buttons.

client_portal.dashboard: Metrics grid: Active projects count, approved value sum, unpaid invoices, upcoming meetings. Includes a visual project timeline widget.
client_portal.projects_tracker: List of client projects retrieved from database. Clicking a project reveals dynamic timeline showing completed milestones, project update timeline logged by supervisor, team members list with photo/avatar and roles, project category, and final hosting/demo links.
client_portal.proposal_negotiation: Grid of proposals submitted by admin. Includes proposal details, service list tags, timeline, and valid_until deadline. Status workflow action: DRAFT proposals can be submitted (DRAFT -> PENDING) or deleted; PENDING/APPROVED/REJECTED are read-only. Clicking 'Approve' triggers payment deposit configuration.
client_portal.document_vault: Upload project requirement details, PSD/Figma mockups, and download project deliverables uploaded by the engineering team. Supports drag-and-drop file upload with progress bar.

staff_portal.dashboard: Quick stats panel showing assigned student counts, total classes, and assignments awaiting grading.
staff_portal.class_attendance: Select class from assigned list -> Select class date -> Lists assigned students -> Tick checkbox (Present/Absent/Late/Excused) with instant single-row database save or bulk save action.
staff_portal.grading_center: Lists incoming assignments from students. Allows filtering by course. Staff can view details, download uploaded files, input score grades (0-100), and write qualitative review feedback.
staff_portal.resource_manager: Simple upload UI to attach videos, PDF slide handouts, and assignment outlines to course modules.

admin_manager_portal.user_administration: Global user data table. Actions: edit roles, toggle status (ACTIVE, SUSPENDED), review comprehensive session logs and security audit trail.
admin_manager_portal.course_builder: Visual builder to add new courses, define duration/level, structure course modules sequentially, append lesson videos/text, and specify full/installment pricing.
admin_manager_portal.project_assignment: Create new projects from approved proposals. Assign staff as supervisor, assign staff team members to the project workspace, allocate budget, and track real-time milestone completions.
admin_manager_portal.finance_ledger: Dynamic ledger of income and expense records. Real-time charts showing Monthly Revenue vs Expenses, listing transactions, with manual entry overrides.
admin_manager_portal.analytics_reports: Charts representing total student enrollments, course success ratios, complaint resolution turnaround times, and staff performance metrics.

security_and_validation.mysqli_prepared_statements: Every single query must run using parameterized statements. Prevent SQL injection by escaping all inputs, using custom query wrapper classes where appropriate.
security_and_validation.session_security: Use session_regenerate_id(true) on login. Set strict session lifetime. Enable session.cookie_secure and session.cookie_httponly.
security_and_validation.csrf_protection: Generate a unique cryptographically secure CSRF token per user session. Embed as hidden fields in all POST/PUT/DELETE forms and check matching token validation on form processing.
security_and_validation.xss_prevention: Implement htmlspecialchars() output escaping on all user-submitted text printed in views, especially forum posts and comments.

payment_integrity.verification: When Paystack callback triggers, fetch transaction status directly from Paystack API by server-side curl request.
payment_integrity.amount_match: Compare callback paid amount (converted from kobo) to the exact database invoice/payment record. Reject and log alert on mismatch.
payment_integrity.idempotency: Validate if the paystack_reference has already been processed successfully inside the database before granting enrollment or marking milestone complete.
payment_integrity.transaction_wrapping: Wrap payment update + enrollment creation + installment tables inserts inside database transactions. Rollback on failure to prevent inconsistent states.

unimplemented_future_features.realtime_notifications: Implement Server-Sent Events (SSE) in PHP to push notifications directly to the student/client header bell widget when an assignment is graded or a milestone is complete.
unimplemented_future_features.document_versioning: Maintain history logs on files uploaded to the CRM vault, tracking upload timestamps, file sizes, and allowing rollbacks to previous versions.
unimplemented_future_features.email_automation: Implement cron-triggered script checks identifying upcoming installment deadlines and sending reminder templates via SMTP (using PHPMailer).
unimplemented_future_features.assessment_wizards: Add interactive client onboarding questionnaire templates that parse user responses to auto-suggest project outline structures and budget estimates.
unimplemented_future_features.forum_resolved_flag: Enable student creators or instructors to mark forum question threads as 'RESOLVED', pinning the correct instructor reply to the top.
unimplemented_future_features.meeting_video_integration: Integrate embedded Jitsi Meet iframe links in scheduled meetings so that client and staff can join video chats directly inside the ERP portal.
